newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Acesita starts as neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Acesita starts as neutral.

text.p: -- Bear Stearns & Co said on Wednesday it had started coverage of Brazilian stainless steel maker Acos Especiais Itabira, or Acesita, with a rating of neutral.
-- Analyst Marco Soligo wrote in a report that Acesita had seen its market share drop to 80 percent from a recent high of 90 percent. Its main product, stainless steel, is relatively easy to import.
-- "The net debt position, which was $321 million at the end of 1995, should reach $870 million by the end of this year," he said.
-- Acesita stock is expensive relative to other major Brazilian steel companies and it has thin operating margins.
-- "In our opinion, it will take several years for this company to get back on track."
-- The company's shares were trading at 2.09 reais, down 0.01.
